segments.text: Before we start, we want to talk about the accident at the venue last month.
Everyone is okay now, but it was frightening, and we are not going to make jokes about it.
The venue has been very good to us and we are going back in the spring.
Right, on to the episode, this week we are talking about microphones again.
Chris has strong opinions about dynamic microphones and he is going to share them.
I do have strong opinions and they are correct.
